name: judge
description: Approval as a multisig of agents. A panel's creator — the box, or anyone signed in with their wallet (mod-protocol token) — sets the params: the judges that sit on it (deterministic rule judges, LLM judges with criteria prompts, agent-protocol agents posed the input as an orbit/agent run, or whole other panels — judges of judges, cycle-safe), each with a GOAL (what that judge is judging for), the approval threshold (0-100) and the quorum; judges can be added one at a time. A judge MARKET lets anyone publish a judge spec and panel creators install listings onto their bench. Every judge is an agent that scores an input 0-100 (POST /score tries a single judge spec); if the weighted average falls under the threshold, or too few judges manage to vote, the verdict is FAIL. Errors fail closed. Every new judge is issued a keyring of multiple key types — classical ed25519 plus the quantum-resistant ml-dsa-65 (FIPS 204) and wots-sha256 (stdlib hash-based) — shown per judge in the console, and every vote is signed by the whole ring, so the append-only verdict record is tamper-evident (GET /verify). One local SQLite file; core is stdlib, ed25519/ml-dsa use the cryptography and dilithium-py libs when present.
state: ~/.mod/judge/judge.db + token (override dir with JUDGE_DIR); JUDGE_TOKEN_MAX_AGE (default 7 days) for sign-in tokens

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, with store stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only the local file
endpoints.GET /panels: Every panel, with params and verdict counts
endpoints.GET /verdicts: The verdict record, newest first (panel, limit, offset)
endpoints.GET /verdict: One verdict with every judge's score and reason (id)
endpoints.GET /verify: Re-check every signature on one verdict (id) — tamper check
endpoints.GET /key_kinds: The signature key types judges are issued (classical + quantum-resistant)
endpoints.GET /market: Browse the judge market, most installed first (q, kind)
endpoints.GET /listing: One market listing with its full judge spec (id)
endpoints.GET /agents: The agent-protocol roster, for agent-judge pickers
endpoints.GET /auth: Who this caller is: role box (loopback / X-Judge-Token), signed (Authorization: Bearer <mod-protocol token>) or anon, with the address
endpoints.POST /judge: Put an input before a panel {panel, input} — avg score vs threshold
endpoints.POST /score: Try one judge spec on an input without a panel {spec, input} — its 0-100 score + reason, nothing recorded — box or signed-in caller
endpoints.POST /create_panel: Create a panel {name, creator, judges, threshold, min_votes} — box or signed-in caller
endpoints.POST /update_panel: Change params {name, creator, ...} — creator only; signed callers act as their address
endpoints.POST /remove_panel: Delete a panel {name, creator} — creator only; signed callers act as their address
endpoints.POST /add_judge: Seat one more judge on a panel {name, creator, judge:{name, kind, goal, ...}} — creator only; signed callers act as their address
endpoints.POST /publish_judge: List a judge on the market {name, author, spec, description, tags} — open
endpoints.POST /unpublish_judge: Take a listing down {id, author} — author only
endpoints.POST /install_judge: Seat a listing on a panel {id, panel, creator, name, weight} — trusted only
endpoints.GET /whoami: Same as /auth — the address a mod-protocol token proves
endpoints.GET /judge_keys: One judge's keyring, public side (panel, judge): public key, fingerprint, algo, quantum_resistant per key type
